tasks.title: Set up GitHub Organization and Repository Structure
tasks.description: Create the GitHub organization and initial repository structure for the TN HETC project
tasks.details: Create GitHub organization 'TN-Higher-Ed-Tech-Collective' or 'TN-HETC'. Create main 'docs' repository with proper README, MIT LICENSE, and .gitignore. Set up additional repositories: 'PowerShell-Scripts', 'Active-Directory', 'VMware-Automation', 'Network-Configs', 'Security-Tools', 'Monitoring-Tools', 'Templates-And-Docs'. Configure repository settings for GitHub Pages deployment. Add repository topics and descriptions. Set up branch protection rules for main branch.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify all repositories are created and accessible. Test that GitHub Pages is enabled on docs repository. Confirm branch protection rules are working. Validate that organization settings allow public repositories and proper member permissions.

subtasks.title: Create GitHub Organization 'TN-HETC'
subtasks.description: Create the GitHub organization named 'TN-HETC' or 'TN-Higher-Ed-Tech-Collective' with appropriate settings for public repositories.
subtasks.details: Use GitHub's organization creation interface, set visibility to public, configure billing if needed, and add initial description about TN Higher Ed Tech Collective project following best practices for organization setup.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify organization exists, is public, and accessible via GitHub URL with correct name and description.

subtasks.title: Set up Main 'docs' Repository with Core Files and GitHub Pages
subtasks.description: Create the main 'docs' repository including README, MIT LICENSE, .gitignore, repository topics, description, and configure GitHub Pages deployment.
subtasks.details: Initialize repo with standard GitHub templates for README.md, LICENSE (MIT), and .gitignore (Node/Astro suitable); add topics like 'documentation', 'astro', 'github-pages'; set description; enable GitHub Pages from main branch /docs folder.
subtasks.testStrategy: Confirm files present and correct; verify GitHub Pages settings active; test Pages URL loads successfully.

subtasks.title: Create 7 Additional Specialized Repositories
subtasks.description: Create repositories: 'PowerShell-Scripts', 'Active-Directory', 'VMware-Automation', 'Network-Configs', 'Security-Tools', 'Monitoring-Tools', 'Templates-And-Docs' with descriptions and topics.
subtasks.details: For each repo: use clear descriptive names, add relevant topics (e.g., 'powershell' for PowerShell-Scripts), write short descriptions matching purpose, initialize with basic README explaining content and usage per GitHub best practices.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify all 7 repos created under organization, check descriptions and topics visible on repo pages.

subtasks.title: Configure Branch Protection Rules for All Repositories
subtasks.description: Set up branch protection rules on the main branch across all 8 repositories to enforce PR reviews and status checks.
subtasks.details: Navigate to each repo Settings > Branches > Add rule for 'main': require PR reviews (1-2 approvers), status checks if applicable, restrict pushes, allow admins to bypass; apply consistently following GitHub security best practices.
subtasks.testStrategy: Attempt direct push to main (should fail); create test PR and verify protection prompts review.

subtasks.title: Verify Organization Settings, Permissions, and Repository Access
subtasks.description: Review and confirm organization settings, member permissions, public repo access, and overall structure completeness.
subtasks.details: Check org settings for public repos allowed, member roles/permissions; verify all repos accessible publicly; ensure topics/descriptions/GitHub Pages functional; document any issues and confirm alignment with project needs.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test public access to all repos and Pages site; simulate member access with test account; run checklist for all required elements present and working.

tasks.title: Initialize Astro with Starlight Theme
tasks.description: Set up the Astro documentation site using astro-terminal-docs theme with Tennessee state branding
tasks.details: Install and configure the astro-terminal-docs theme from https://github.com/wyre-technology/astro-terminal-docs. Configure astro.config.mjs with Tennessee state colors (#002D65 blue, #CC0000 red, #FFFFFF white), site metadata, and navigation structure. Create custom CSS file with Tennessee branding. Set up proper site configuration for GitHub Pages deployment with correct base URL. Configure social links for GitHub and Discord (placeholder). Add logo and favicon assets. Set up editLink configuration pointing to GitHub repository.
tasks.testStrategy: Run 'npm run dev' to verify local development server works. Test that all navigation links are functional. Verify Tennessee state colors are applied correctly with the terminal theme. Test responsive design on mobile devices. Confirm that edit links point to correct GitHub URLs. Verify terminal theme styling works properly.

subtasks.title: Initialize Astro project and install astro-terminal-docs theme
subtasks.description: Create a new Astro project and install the astro-terminal-docs theme from the GitHub repository
subtasks.details: Initialize a new Astro project with 'npm create astro@latest' and select minimal template. Install the astro-terminal-docs theme by following the installation instructions from https://github.com/wyre-technology/astro-terminal-docs. Run 'npm install' and configure the theme in astro.config.mjs. Run 'npm run dev' to confirm basic functionality.
subtasks.testStrategy: Start dev server with 'npm run dev' and verify astro-terminal-docs theme loads correctly with terminal-style UI and theme functionality working properly.

subtasks.title: Configure astro.config.mjs with site metadata and navigation
subtasks.description: Update Astro configuration file with Tennessee state site title, description, navigation structure, social links, and editLink settings for the terminal theme
subtasks.details: Edit astro.config.mjs to set site title, description, logo paths, social links for GitHub and Discord (placeholder), navigation items for docs sections, and editLink base to GitHub repository URL. Configure astro-terminal-docs specific options and settings as needed for the theme.
subtasks.testStrategy: Restart dev server and verify site title displays correctly, navigation menu shows configured items, social icons appear in footer, and edit links point to correct GitHub URLs within the terminal theme interface.

subtasks.title: Implement custom Tennessee state branding CSS and assets for terminal theme
subtasks.description: Create custom CSS with Tennessee colors and add logo/favicon assets for state branding compatible with the terminal theme
subtasks.details: Add Tennessee logo and favicon to src/assets/. Create custom CSS file defining CSS custom properties for Tennessee state colors (#002D65 blue primary, #CC0000 red accent, #FFFFFF white) that work with the astro-terminal-docs theme styling. Override theme defaults while maintaining terminal aesthetic. Include light/dark logo variants if needed.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify Tennessee state colors apply correctly within the terminal theme styling in light/dark modes using dev server. Check logo/favicon display in browser tab and site header. Test responsive branding on mobile viewport sizes with terminal theme layout.

subtasks.title: Set up GitHub Pages deployment config and editLink for terminal theme
subtasks.description: Configure base URL for GitHub Pages deployment and finalize editLink repository pointing compatible with astro-terminal-docs theme
subtasks.details: Set base: '/docs-repo-name/' in astro.config.mjs for GitHub Pages deployment. Configure editLink with correct GitHub repository URL pattern that works with the terminal theme. Update deploy adapter if needed for Pages compatibility with astro-terminal-docs. Test build output location and asset paths.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run 'npm run build' and verify output in dist/ includes correct asset paths with base URL and terminal theme assets. Check that edit buttons on pages link to proper GitHub file edit URLs and display correctly within the terminal theme interface.

tasks.title: Create Core Site Structure and Navigation
tasks.description: Implement the complete directory structure and navigation system as specified in the PRD
tasks.details: Create directory structure in src/content/docs/ following PRD specifications: about/, get-started/, resources/, community/, events/. Set up sidebar navigation in astro.config.mjs with proper hierarchy and links. Create index files for each major section. Implement breadcrumb navigation and table of contents. Configure search functionality. Set up proper heading hierarchy and internal linking structure. Ensure all navigation items have corresponding placeholder pages.
tasks.testStrategy: Test all navigation links work correctly. Verify sidebar navigation expands and collapses properly. Test search functionality returns relevant results. Confirm breadcrumb navigation shows correct path. Test that table of contents generates automatically and links work. Verify mobile navigation hamburger menu functions properly.

subtasks.title: Create Directory Structure
subtasks.description: Create the specified directory structure in src/content/docs/ following PRD specifications.
subtasks.details: Create directories: about/, get-started/, resources/, community/, events/ inside src/content/docs/. Ensure structure aligns with Astro/Starlight docs conventions for content collections[1][6].
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify directories exist with correct paths and permissions. Check no files conflict with Astro build process.

subtasks.title: Configure Sidebar Navigation
subtasks.description: Set up sidebar navigation in astro.config.mjs with proper hierarchy and links per PRD.
subtasks.details: Update astro.config.mjs to define sidebar items for all sections (about, get-started, etc.) with nested hierarchy. Use Starlight sidebar configuration format.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test sidebar renders correctly, expands/collapses, and all links resolve to correct paths.

subtasks.title: Implement Index Files and Placeholders
subtasks.description: Create index.md files for each major section and corresponding placeholder pages.
subtasks.details: Add index.md in about/, get-started/, resources/, community/, events/. Create basic placeholder.md pages for all navigation items with frontmatter (title, description).
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify all index pages load without errors. Confirm placeholder pages render with proper headings and no broken links.

subtasks.title: Add Breadcrumb Navigation
subtasks.description: Implement breadcrumb navigation component showing current page path.
subtasks.details: Create or configure Breadcrumb.astro component in src/components/. Integrate into layout to display hierarchy based on current URL path.
subtasks.testStrategy: Navigate through sections; verify breadcrumbs show correct path and are clickable back to parents.

subtasks.title: Configure Search Functionality
subtasks.description: Set up site-wide search functionality integrated with docs content.
subtasks.details: Configure Starlight/Astro search in astro.config.mjs. Ensure search indexes all docs content including placeholders. Test basic search queries.
subtasks.testStrategy: Search for section names and verify relevant results appear. Test no results for invalid queries.

subtasks.title: Set Up TOC and Mobile Navigation
subtasks.description: Implement table of contents and ensure mobile-responsive navigation.
subtasks.details: Enable Starlight TOC component with automatic generation from headings. Configure mobile menu toggle, ensure sidebar collapses on mobile and all nav elements responsive.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify TOC generates/links correctly on pages with headings. Test mobile viewport: menu opens/closes, all links accessible via touch.

tasks.title: Develop Custom Homepage with Hero Section

subtasks.testStrategy: Confirm page renders with full-width layout, no sidebar visible, and proper Starlight splash template structure.

subtasks.title: Implement Hero Section with Branding and CTAs
subtasks.description: Add hero section to index.mdx with Tennessee Higher Ed Tech Collective branding, tagline, and primary CTAs
subtasks.details: Within index.mdx, implement hero using custom MDX components or HTML with Tennessee state colors (navy blue, gold). Include organization logo/name, tagline, and CTA buttons linking to Discord/GitHub placeholders (e.g., #discord, #github). Ensure prominent, responsive design.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify hero displays branding correctly, CTAs are styled with hover effects, and responsive on mobile/desktop. Check placeholder links don't break.

subtasks.title: Add Value Propositions Using Card and CardGrid

subtasks.title: Build Quick Links and Recent Activity Sections

subtasks.details: Implement Quick Links section with CardGrid linking to about/, get-started/, resources/ (use paths from Task 3). tasks.title: Set up GitHub Actions Deployment Pipeline
tasks.description: Configure automated deployment to GitHub Pages with proper CI/CD workflow
tasks.details: Create .github/workflows/deploy.yml with Node.js 20, npm caching, Astro build process, and GitHub Pages deployment. Configure workflow to trigger on push to main branch and manual dispatch. Set up proper permissions for pages deployment (contents: read, pages: write, id-token: write). Include build artifact upload and deployment steps. Add error handling and build status reporting. Configure concurrency settings to prevent multiple deployments. Test deployment process thoroughly.
tasks.testStrategy: Test deployment workflow by pushing to main branch. Verify site builds successfully and deploys to GitHub Pages. Confirm that build failures are properly reported. Test manual workflow dispatch functionality. Verify that concurrent deployments are handled correctly. Test that site is accessible at GitHub Pages URL after deployment.

subtasks.title: Create deploy.yml with Node.js, Astro build, caching, and artifact upload
subtasks.description: Author the core .github/workflows/deploy.yml file including Node.js 20 setup, npm caching, Astro build process, and build artifact upload steps.
subtasks.details: Include 'setup-node@v4' with Node 20, 'actions/cache@v4' for npm dependencies, 'npm ci' install, 'npm run build' for Astro, and 'actions/upload-pages-artifact' for dist directory. Structure as multi-job workflow with build job first.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify workflow syntax with GitHub Actions linting tools. Check that build job completes successfully on manual dispatch without deployment.

subtasks.title: Configure triggers, permissions, concurrency, and GitHub Pages deployment
subtasks.description: Add workflow triggers, permissions, concurrency controls, error handling, and Pages deployment steps to deploy.yml.
subtasks.details: Set 'on: push: branches: [main], workflow_dispatch'. Add permissions: {contents: read, pages: write, id-token: write}. Configure 'concurrency: group: pages, cancel-in-progress: true'. Include 'actions/deploy-pages' job dependent on build artifact. Add status reporting with '::notice::' and error handling with 'if: failure()' steps.
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate permissions don't cause auth failures. Test concurrency by triggering multiple dispatches. Confirm deployment job only runs after successful build.

subtasks.title: Test automated, manual, and concurrent deployments to GitHub Pages
subtasks.description: Thoroughly test the complete deployment pipeline including automated push triggers, manual dispatch, and concurrency handling.
subtasks.details: Push commits to main branch to test auto-deploy. Use GitHub UI to test manual workflow_dispatch. Trigger concurrent deployments to verify cancellation. Check GitHub Pages site updates correctly and access via custom domain if configured. Review action logs for errors and status reporting.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify site deploys successfully to https://<username>.github.io/<repo>/. Confirm build failures are reported clearly. Test that only latest deployment succeeds in concurrent scenarios. Validate Pages settings show 'GitHub Actions' as source.

subtasks.title: Mobile Responsiveness and Accessibility Audits
subtasks.description: Conduct mobile optimization testing and full accessibility audit including contrast verification
subtasks.details: Test responsive breakpoints on mobile devices/tablets. Run axe DevTools and Lighthouse accessibility audits ensuring WCAG AA compliance.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test iOS Safari, Chrome Android at various screen sizes. Lighthouse score >90 for accessibility. Verify all contrast ratios pass[1][2][4]

subtasks.title: Complete Link Validation Testing
subtasks.description: Test all internal and external links for functionality and proper HTTP status codes
subtasks.details: Use link checker tools or custom script to validate all href attributes. Fix broken links and 404s. Test Discord/GitHub external links.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run automated link checker, manually test all navigation and footer links, verify external links resolve correctly

subtasks.title: Final Content Review and Launch Preparation
subtasks.description: Perform content proofreading, prepare launch checklist and documentation
subtasks.details: Review all content for grammar, consistency, Tennessee branding tone. Create launch checklist covering deployment, monitoring, post-launch tasks.
subtasks.testStrategy: Peer review content, validate against PRD requirements, test launch checklist items in staging environment
